title: Why PC Games Stutter the First Time
description:
A new effect appears, the game hitches once and the same scene runs smoothly the next time. This short animation explains pipeline state objects, why a missing graphics pipeline can interrupt a frame and how a cached pipeline changes the second run.

Sources:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3d12/managing-graphics-pipeline-state-in-direct3d-12
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/samples/microsoft/directx-graphics-samples/d3d12-pipeline-state-cache-sample-win32/
https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/advanced-api-performance-pipeline-state-objects/

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: generated locally with Kokoro TTS.
Music: an original ElevenLabs sound-effects bed licensed for finished editorial video.
Synthetic media disclosure: Yes.
